Storefront and customer routes of the search module. Send `Accept-Language` (or `X-Locale` from a browser) on every call; a customer route needs the session cookie.

## GET /v1/search

Search products

Parameters:

- `brand` in query (string, max length 100, optional).
- `categoryId` in query (string, optional).
- `inStock` in query (boolean, optional).
- `page` in query (number, min 1, optional).
- `pageSize` in query (number, min 1, max 100, optional).
- `priceMax` in query (number, min 0, optional).
- `priceMin` in query (number, min 0, optional).
- `q` in query (string, max length 200, optional).
- `rating` in query (number, min 1, max 5, optional).

Responses:

- `200`: Search results.

## POST /v1/search/events/{id}/click

Log product click

Parameters:

- `id` in path (string, required).

Request body: [LogClickDto](#logclickdto).

Responses:

- `204`: Click logged.

## POST /v1/search/events/{id}/convert

Log product conversion

Parameters:

- `id` in path (string, required).

Responses:

- `204`: Conversion logged.

## GET /v1/search/filters

Get search filters

Parameters:

- `q` in query (string, required).

Responses:

- `200`: Filters retrieved.

## GET /v1/search/suggest

Get search suggestions

Parameters:

- `q` in query (string, min length 1, max length 100, required).

Responses:

- `200`: Suggestions retrieved.

## Schemas

### LogClickDto

- `clickedProductId` (string, required).
- `clickPosition` (number, min 0, required).
